newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-Contal begun market perform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Contal begun market perform.

text.p: Santander Investment said on Thursday it began coverage of Mexican bottler Grupo Continental (Contal) with a market perform rating.

Santander analysts Henry Garrido and Alexander Robarts expect ordinary earnings per share of $0.15 and $0.16 for 1997 and 1998, respectively. In 1996 the company reported earnings of $0.11 per share, they said.
"Although we believe the shares have some upside potential, on a 12-month horizon, we expect that the company will perform in line with the market," the analysts wrote.
They projected a 19 percent operating margin for 1997, up 220 basis points from 1996.

"In 1997, Contal should maintain its high operating profitability, owing to improving soft drink and sugar volume growth, a real average price increase of two percent and, to a lesser expent, the expansion of its new purified water business," Santander said in a statement.
Contal shares stood at 19.20 pesos in mid-day trading, up 30 centavos.
